The prevalence of venue subsidies generated an extensive and vibrant research literature, which spans over 30 years and includes more than 130 studies.
Though findings have become more nuanced, recent analyses continue to confirm the decades-old consensus of very limited economic impacts of professional sports teams and stadiums.
Thus, the large subsidies commonly devoted to constructing professional sports venues are not justified as worthwhile public investments.
